name: Cleric Artifact Acolyte
body:
The acolytes of the artifact are those who have seen the power and influence of the void artifact and found their minds twisted and broken. The only hope for them is to aid such a powerful object in its alien goals.

Alignment: An artifact acolyte cultist must be neutral evil. This alters the cleric’s required alignment.

Deities: An artifact acolyte worships no god but only the void artifact.

Domains: An artifact acolyte receives only a single domain (and subdomain), chosen from the following: Madness (with any subdomain) or Void (with any subdomain). This ability alters domains.

Aura (Ex)

An artifact acolyte exudes an aura of evil as a cleric of an evil deity. This ability alters aura.

Marked by the Artifact (Ex)

An artifact acolyte has had their mind altered by contact with the void artifact. Their sanity wanes and the voice of the artifact guides their actions. They use Charisma instead of Wisdom as their key spellcasting ability score (to determine their spell DCs, bonus spells per day, bonus on concentration checks, and so on), to determine the effects and number of uses of their domain powers, and to modify their Will saving throws.

Additionally, necrophage creatures will not attack an artifact acolyte unless the artifact acolyte commits a hostile action them first. The necrophage can sense the void artifact’s influence upon the mind of the acolyte. The Void Artifact can directly command a necrophage creature to attack an artifact acolyte.

Artifact acolytes automatically fail any Will saving throw imposed by the void artifact. If the void artifact takes damage during a mental duel (see the destruction section of the void artifact), they are confused as per the confusion spell for 1d4 rounds from the psychological shockwave. If the void artifact is destroyed, it drives the artifact acolyte permanently insane as is affected by the spell insanity. This now absence in the acolyte’s mind is so profound that is can only be healed by a miracle or wish spell.

Artifact Channeling (Su)

At 1st level, an artifact acolyte channels energy like a cleric.

However, the energy channeled is neither positive or negative, but instead the psychic energy generated by the void artifact. It harms living creatures (that might act as good hosts) and heals necrophage creatures. Feats or other abilities that require channeling positive or negative energy will not work with this ability but other feats like Extra Channeling or Selective Channeling will work. This ability modifies channel energy.

Create Necrophage (Su)

At 8th level, an artifact acolyte can transfer some of the psychic energy from the void artifact into a viable dead body with and create a necrophage creature.

Doing so is a standard-action melee touch that provokes attacks of opportunity. See the infect with necrophage ability on page 4 under the necrophage infector. The artifact acolyte can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1/2 their cleric level.

The Void Artifact

Aura Overwhelming transmutation; CL 20th; Slot none; Price -; Weight immense

DESCRIPTION

This artifact is made of some unidentifiable mineral and it formed into an alien twisting structure covered in strange runic markings from a long dead language. It glows with a dim red light from its crevices. It is an intelligent object that communicates mentally with its necrophage creations and any being that remains within 1 mile of it for more than 1 hour.

Once the connection to a living creature is established, the creature must make a DC 20 Will save every hour or take 1d2 Wisdom drain as it communicates and tries to take over the creature’s mind. Additionally, the artifact can cast dominate monster once per minute against such creatures. Additionally, the artifact can cast overwhelming presence once per day. If a creature with a connection to the artifact dies or takes Wisdom drain equal to their Wisdom score while connected, they become a necrophage creature of the artifact’s choice. The connection, once made, never leaves the target, though if they are more than a mile away, they do not need to make Will saves. The artifact will continue to communicate with the subject calling them to come back using the subjects own memories. This communication spans planes and distance and can only be ended by destroying the artifact. The artifact will send necrophagic creatures after an errant creature that has survived and left its direct influence unless the creature is serving its own goals.

DESTRUCTION

If damaged the alien artifact will rebuild itself. The only way to destroy the artifact is for a living creature to engage in a mental combat with the artifact. To do so, the creature must have established a connection to the artifact and consciously attack it with its mind. They must be within 100 feet and take a full-round to roll a d20 and take the highest of their Wisdom, Intelligence or Charisma modifiers against a DC 20. Each successful check deals 1d8 + the highest of their Wisdom, Intelligence or Charisma modifiers to the artifact. If the check fails, the creature is instantly subject to the Will save to resist the Wisdom drain. The artifact has 50 hit points for the purposes of this mental combat and has fast healing 2.
